title: Giant UFO Emerges From the Sun as Cube Appears
excerpt: A giant UFO emerges from the Sun as a mysterious cube suddenly appears and disappears, leaving a bizarre celestial mystery unexplained.
content:
A staggering cosmic anomaly captured in solar observations has ignited intense debate among anomaly researchers and space enthusiasts worldwide.

Prominent UFO researcher Scott Waring brought attention to raw footage showing a massive planet-sized entity departing from our star. Moments after emerging from the solar surface, a mysterious geometric cube flashed directly in front of the craft.

The gargantuan structure features an undeniable ring-like outline surrounding its dark core as it moves through space. What truly baffles analysts is the sudden appearance of the geometric cube. The strange shape materializes out of nowhere, lingers momentarily, and then vanishes instantly into the dark vacuum. 

Waring discussed the unusual images in a video published on October 17 and in a follow-up article on UFO Sightings Daily. He believes the footage could show an enormous unidentified spacecraft leaving the Sun. He even suggests that the object could be a planet-sized alien craft capable of cloaking itself.

While examining the footage, Waring draws attention to what appears to be a huge object surrounded by a distinctive ring-like structure. He moves through the images to highlight the moment when a cube-shaped feature suddenly becomes visible in front of it. The feature then appears to vanish.

VIDEO. Giant Sphere Exits Sun On NASA Sun Images! Oct 17 2026, UFO UAP Sighting News.

His explanation goes far beyond the images themselves. Waring proposes that advanced alien craft could use the Sun as a source of energy. He also speculates that enormous protected structures might exist inside the star, allowing hypothetical spacecraft to operate there before travelling back into space.

To view the mysterious photo on Nascom.Nasa, select Image C2. Dates 2026-10-17 – 2026-10-17 and click Generate. When scrolling through the photos, look for the time and date starting from 03:00 2026-10-17.

The researcher connects his theory to Planet X and Nibiru, names associated with claims about a mysterious, undiscovered world. However, the video does not establish a connection between the solar object and either of these hypothetical bodies.

The apparent object and the fleeting cube are intriguing visual features, but their appearance alone cannot establish their true nature. Solar imaging can produce unusual shapes through instrument effects, image processing and other observational artifacts.

Still, the footage raises a question that viewers may find difficult to ignore: what exactly are they seeing in these images? Until the original observations can be independently examined, the identity of the object and the brief cube-like feature remains unresolved.

Is this extraordinary visual event merely a digital glitch created by raw satellite data transmission? Or did space cameras capture a rare glimpse of an unknown intelligence moving through our solar system?

Sources of information: UFO Sightings Daily — Planet-Size UFO Exits Sun; Scott Waring’s video on YouTube.

It was previously reported that one UFO researcher claims that a giant blue object spotted near several supernovae may be a massive alien spacecraft. This mysterious object was discovered during a sky survey by the World Wide Telescope program.
